page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-64-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM capacity relative to compute resources.

The instance utilizes dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants. It does not include any GPU accelerators, and local storage is specified as none. The system also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture combined with a high-density memory profile offers a balanced resource tradeoff for enterprise workloads. This server type is designed for memory-heavy applications such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics, and enterprise resource planning applications that benefit from a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
